Rules: Context: `hcloud context list` (active: hetzner). Do not run `hcloud context use/create/delete`.

READ-ONLY: only list/describe verbs (server, network, volume, firewall, ssh-key, image, load-balancer, floating-ip). Never create, delete, rebuild, power off/reset, attach/detach or change firewall rules unless the prompt has an AUTHORIZED WRITE block naming the exact resource.
Prefer `-o json` and filter with jq.

CliTools.Name: hcloud
CliTools.UseCase: Hetzner Cloud CLI. Example: `hcloud server list -o json`, `hcloud server describe <name>`, `hcloud firewall list`.
